subject: Staged Billing Gateway rollout: split allocation schema & retro-credit rules
messages:
From: Leah Patel <l.patel@arborsense.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Multi-entity invoice split + cost center tagging (ArborSense)

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our finance team is ready to move forward but we need a clear approach for invoicing across our four legal entities (US/UK/EU/AU) and for routing charges to product cost centers. Key asks from our side:

- Single consolidated invoice that can be split automatically by entity and include per-line cost center tags.
- Retroactive credits when seats are moved between cost centers during the billing month.
- VAT handling: for EU entity we need reverse-charge flags and for UK a separate VAT line.
- Exportable mapping file (CSV) our ERP can ingest.

Can you put together an implementation proposal and a short pilot plan? We’d like to pilot with our beta customers (10 accounts) in December.

Attaching a simple workbook with ArborSense's current entity IDs for reference.

Leah
Leah Patel
Head of Finance, ArborSense
leah.patel@arborsense.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: arbor_entity_ids.xlsx (referenced)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Leah Patel <l.patel@arborsense.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-entity invoice split + cost center tagging (ArborSense)

Leah —

Appreciate the clear list. I’ve sketched a staged rollout that balances product effort and your accounting needs. Summary below — detailed plan attached (split-invoice-proposal-v2.xlsx) and the allocation mapping template is allocation-matrix.csv.

High level approach:
- Phase 1 (pilot, Dec): Consolidated invoice generated from a single billing run. Invoice engine will emit a single PDF and a machine-readable companion (CSV/JSON) with per-line entity_id and cost_center_code. Finance can run our ingestion to split lines into four AR journals.
- Phase 2 (Jan): Automated split invoice delivery — each entity receives its own invoice email and payment instructions. Internal routing tags on every line to preserve cost-center fidelity.
- Retro credits: We’ll include a nightly reconciliation job that looks at seat-moves and emits retro-credit line items dated to the original invoice period. For pilot we’ll surface credits as separate line items with a reference to the original charge ID.
- VAT/Tax: Default ruleset per entity; we’ll support reverse-charge boolean on line-level for EU buyer-supplied VAT IDs and a separate VAT summary line for UK.

Operational asks for ArborSense (what we need from you):
- Confirm entity mapping CSV (sample in allocation-matrix.csv).
- Provide one month of anonymized invoice history for 3 pilot accounts (for testing reconciliation).
- Point person for tax questions (name/email) so we can loop Legal/Tax early.

Timeline (target): Pilot kick-off Dec 6 — pilot invoices Dec 15-20; feedback loop through Jan 5; Phase 2 live Jan 20.

I’ll coordinate with Billing engineering and Tax/Legal. Kimberly — can you confirm we’re OK with the retro-credit audit trail as described? Ben — I’ll need a test plan from Payments for the split-delivery emails/payment instructions.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Product Manager, Billing
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Attachments: split-invoice-proposal-v2.xlsx; allocation-matrix.csv
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Patel <l.patel@arborsense.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-entity invoice split + cost center tagging (ArborSense)

Marcus —

This looks good from a product perspective. A few compliance/tax items to make explicit before pilot:

- Audit trail: Each retro-credit must include (a) original charge ID, (b) triggering user ID, (c) timestamp of move, and (d) reason code. That must be present in the CSV export for our SOC/audit reviewers.
- VAT proof: For reverse-charge lines we need buyer VAT ID and the invoice must include the statutory reverse-charge statement for the EU entity.
- Currency rounding: When splitting a single consolidated amount across entities we must apply allocation rounding rules (round half-even) and provide a small residual-balancing line if totals diverge.

Also: Legal requests that any per-entity payment instructions be accompanied by a short terms snippet (we can provide language) and that DocuSign be used for the pilot's master amendment if ArborSense wants to proceed (link: https://app.docusign.com/agreements/ABC-Remit-Amend).

Looping Legal? I’ll kick off Legal review but want Marcus to confirm the exact CSV column names (we should match the allocation-matrix.csv headers).

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

All —

Count me in. Payments team can support the split-delivery and separate remittance routing. Quick notes:

- Pilot scope: we should limit to 10 customer accounts as proposed and restrict currency conversions (pilot in USD only).
- Test plan deliverable: I’ll send a short checklist (test cases + expected CSV columns) by EOD Wed.
- Risk: one-off chargebacks during pilot — we’ll mark those with a special tag so Finance can reconcile manually.

Leah — if ArborSense signs the amendment (DocuSign link Kimberly shared) we’ll schedule a brief operational runbook session (30 min) before Dec 6.

Ben Carter
